about: Every column of the five tables the partners page edits, each either with the registry path it is edited at or excluded with a reason (#2132, L96). supabase/tests/partner_page_columns.test.sql fails when a table gains a column this file does not list; apps/web/src/app/(app)/partners/__tests__/partner-field-registry.test.ts fails when a path here matches no registry entry, or more than one. Paths are in the registry's spelling: a partner field as its name, a buyer profile path under profile. in the TypeScript spelling. An exclusion's kind is identity (who or what the row is, never edited), bookkeeping (about a change, not the change; for partner_configs exactly the columns partner_configs_unversioned_columns() names that the page does not edit) or retired (a column the page no longer edits, kept until a contract step drops it).

organization_id.reason: The owning organization, taken from the token, never the page.

bid_mode.reason: Off the page since PM-9 (#2136): nothing acts on it. The engine and the money gate still read it, so the column stays until its contract step drops it.
